import numpy as np
p = np.random.default_rng(71).uniform(0, 6, (3, 3))
x = np.array([0.2, 1.7])
y = np.array([0.1, 1.9, 4.7])
z = np.array([0.0, 0.003, 0.009])

def _case_encode_volume(value, shape):
    result = np.asarray(value)
    if result.shape != shape or result.dtype.kind not in "iuf" or not np.isfinite(result).all():
        raise AssertionError("volume_field must return a finite real field with the contracted shape")
    return result * (1e-9 / 2e-6)
assert np.allclose(_case_encode_volume(volume_field(x.copy(), y.copy(), z.copy(), p.copy(), seed_bounds(p.copy())), (len(z), len(x), len(y), 3)), target)
